_comment: Wet-lab-validated primer sets that must be preferred over a fresh computational design whenever their genomic (isolate-annealing) body matches the requested isolate's curated sequence. Keyed by 'gene|application' (application implies vector: deletion -> pEXG2, expression -> pBBR1MCS2). Only the isolate-annealing body is fixed here; vector-homology tails (and, for expression, the RBS) are always derived the same way as for computationally-designed primers (vectors.derive_tails / RBS_TAIL_PART), so the tool's own tail conventions stay authoritative and self-consistent. See lib/primer_design/fixed_primers.py.

lasB|deletion.note: PA14 lasB in-frame deletion set. P4 anneals ~628 nt downstream of the stop codon, i.e. outside the curated 600 nt dn_flank window — matching against this isolate's genome may require widening the flank from the full genome (see fixed_primers._wide_flanks).

lasB|expression.note: PA14 lasB complementation set (pBBR1MCS-2). P1 body includes 8 nt of native upstream context between the RBS and the start codon (annealed from the genome, not the tool's synthetic spacer) — confirmed with the primer designer 2026-07-27.
